name: Wirt Slider
author: Rostyslav Wirt

sections.description:
Wirt Slider is a responsive, easy-to-use slider plugin for WordPress powered by KeenSlider.
It allows you to create a clean, customizable Gutenberg block – slider for your site without writing any shortcode.

Key Features:
* Fully responsive slider block for Gutenberg
* Customizable vertical spacing (top and bottom)
* Adjustable slider background color
* Customizable navigation button colors with hover effects
* Customizable dot colors and spacing
* Custom image caption text and background colors
* Full-size slide display in a modal window
* Lightweight and fast performance
* Easy configuration via WordPress admin

Additional Notes

  • All settings are sanitized and validated for security.
  • Built following WordPress coding standards.
  • Uses KeenSlider for high-performance animations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wirt-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Wirt Slider to configure spacing, colors, and navigation options.
  4. Add your slider in post wherever needed — it will display automatically with the configured settings.
sections.faq:
Does Wirt Slider support multiple sliders per page?

Currently, it is designed for a single main slider. Multiple sliders can be added manually with custom code if needed.

Can I change the dot color and navigation button styles?

Yes! All colors and spacing are fully configurable in the Settings → Wirt Slider panel.
